BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.scope: Snapshot attached to the incoming demand; virtual static completion exists only in run-2. Query totals are across actual calls in that snapshot, not distinct semantic rows.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.ownerEvaluations: Completed inherited-view Boolean owner-family computations. Local exact owner checks and ownRows binary searches do not increment it. A fresh view owns a fresh memo.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.ownerHits: Requests answered by already computed positive/negative owner-family memo cells.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.ownerMemoViews: Views which first allocate a byte owner memo.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.ownerMemoAllocatedBytes: Logical ByteArray element capacity across allocated memos; excludes object headers and allocation padding. Not retained byte census.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c2Direct: Actual DemandStore.initials calls, including ordinary local-only calls.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c2Covered: Queries which stop with all known exact initial keys covered at a checked stage.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c2Local/c2Visible: C2 search-stage invocations, not successfully found paths.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c2Roots/c2States/c2Joins: Enumerated producer roots, admitted unique geometry states and exact geometry join checks. No sampled estimate.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5Candidates/c5Restrict: Paired candidate offers and AP restriction attempts, including ordinary local pairs and virtual static pairs.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5States: New complete static path states admitted to one C5 walk; different sources/marks remain distinct.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5FixedReject: Failures of final mapped right canStoreInitial. Selected label skips and new mapped-geometry precheck rejects do not increment it. A lower count alone does not prove proportional time savings.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5Duplicate: Repeated complete states offered to a C5 walk.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5Popped/c5Expand: Dequeued C5 states and those whose source is static and can expand.
BIDI_STATIC_CLOSURE_LOOKUP.c5ComposeAttempts/c5ComposeAccepted: Selected/filtered predecessor rows passed to composition and successful full anchor/overlap/mark joins. Index-eliminated labels are not counted.

BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.scope: Per completed engine; sums copied from actor caches at freeze. Not available for failed partial engines.
BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.hits: Cached start/base lookups including cached empty frontiers.
BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.searches: Completed cache misses installed, one per queried actor/start/base. Cancelled search is not installed/counted.
BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.visitedNodes: Nodes dequeued by completed BFS searches, including relevant frontier nodes.
BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.destinations: Total frontier widths of installed miss rows; hit deliveries are not added.
BIDI_CFG_DELIVERY_STATISTICS.maxWidth: Maximum installed frontier width across actors. This is not total cached integer count by itself.

BIDI_FLOW_BACKED_STATISTICS.scope: Completed run-1 FULL only; per-actor counters summed.
BIDI_FLOW_BACKED_STATISTICS.neutralMemberships: Processed marks in a certified plain-statement batch, not unique ordinary facts.
BIDI_FLOW_BACKED_STATISTICS.bulkStoreMemberships: Fresh diagonal mark memberships admitted once at the producing statement, before successor fanout.
BIDI_FLOW_BACKED_STATISTICS.scalarStoreFallbackMemberships: Memberships sent through the exact scalar fallback; not measured scalar fact allocation count.

BIDI_ABSTRACTION_STATISTICS.scope: START/END totals come from shared counters accumulated across runs. Subtract additive numeric counters for one engine; do not subtract peaks/histograms as if additive.
BIDI_ABSTRACTION_STATISTICS.newInitials: Actual initial identities newly admitted, separate from number of candidate emissions.
BIDI_ABSTRACTION_STATISTICS.initialCandidates: Offered candidate initial identities, including duplicates.
BIDI_ABSTRACTION_STATISTICS.restrictedIntersections: Restricted input-admission intersections; not C5 summary restrictions.
